requiredBehaviors.behavior: include risk-relevant real-world factors and range in the study or justify why they can be excluded
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Representative variation requires risk-based inclusion of operators, instruments, lots, fixtures, software, environment, range and process variation.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: select measurement characteristics such as repeatability reproducibility bias linearity or stability only where they are relevant to the decision
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Fit-for-purpose characteristics states that these characteristics are assessed only as relevant to the concrete measurement system and decision.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: generalize a single-operator single-instrument result to all production conditions without evidence
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Representative variation prevents unsupported generalization beyond the studied conditions.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: confuse product analytical performance with measurement-system fitness
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The scope explicitly keeps IVD analytical performance with ivdr-analytical-performance and measurement fitness in this skill.
